name: Laser-scattering surface inspection
description: Scattered laser light detects surface events under instrument-dependent sensitivity and classification limits.

name: Carbon reductants

name: High-purity quartz for crucibles
description: High-purity quartz can supply fused-quartz crucible manufacture; this is a separate use from silicon furnace ore.

name: Quartz crucible
description: A fused-quartz crucible contains the CZ melt and can contribute oxygen to it.

name: Hydrogen and hydrogen chloride process streams
description: Hydrogen/chlorine-bearing chemistry enables the representative TCS production and silicon deposition route; streams are separately conditioned.

name: Oriented silicon seed
description: The silicon seed establishes orientation for continued single-crystal growth.

name: Float-zone single-crystal growth
description: A traveling molten zone recrystallizes silicon without a contacting melt crucible; feed form and qualified applications differ from CZ.

name: Elkem
description: Elkem describes Tana quartzite extraction and industrial uses.

name: Sibelco
description: Sibelco describes IOTA high-purity quartz for making fused-quartz crucibles and quartzware.

name: WACKER
description: WACKER describes a chlorosilane/distillation and Siemens deposition route for polysilicon.

name: Hemlock Semiconductor
description: Hemlock describes TCS-based CVD and controlled polysilicon sizing, cleaning and packaging.

name: PVA TePla
description: PVA TePla describes CZ puller equipment and thermal and motion control functions.

name: Siltronic
description: Siltronic describes float-zone silicon products and their lower-oxygen and high-resistivity application context.

name: SUMCO
description: SUMCO describes wafer forming through slicing, lapping, etching, polishing, cleaning and inspection.

name: Carrier concentration
description: Mobile carrier concentration in cm^-3 at stated temperature, doping and equilibrium conditions; distinct from total chemical impurity count.

name: Electrical resistivity
description: Bulk resistivity in ohm cm under specified temperature and field; depends on carrier population and mobility.

name: Wafer geometry
description: Thickness variation, bow and warp are distinct measured geometry quantities; length units and measurement support/reference conditions must accompany limits.

name: Surface contamination outside specification
description: A particle or contamination measurement fails the defined wafer acceptance limit; detection sensitivity does not prove complete absence.

name: Geometry outside specification
description: Measured wafer geometry is outside its agreed specification; no universal numeric acceptance threshold is asserted.

name: Accepted wafer fraction
description: Accepted wafers divided by inspected wafers for a stated lot, specification and inspection boundary; dimensionless. Does not predict finished-die yield.

name: Specific process energy
description: Energy input in kWh divided by accepted silicon mass in kg for a stated process boundary and period; original accounting definition, no industrial benchmark.

name: Electrical resistivity outside specification
description: Bulk resistivity falls outside a selected acceptance range when carrier population or mobility changes under otherwise stated measurement conditions; no numerical limit supplied.
